items.title: Javonte Williams: Scores again in Week 6 defeat
items.text:
Williams rushed 11 times for 41 yards and a touchdown while catching both of his targets for nine yards in Sunday's 23-13 loss to the Packers.

items.title: Dak Prescott: Late TD not enough in Week 6 loss
items.text:
Prescott completed 34 of 54 passes for 258 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions in Sunday's 23-13 loss to the Packers. He also rushed twice for seven yards.
